the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

arguments.command:
cd scripts && for f in *.sh; do
  first=$(head -n 1 "$f")
  if [ "$first" != "#!/bin/bash" ]; then echo "SKIP: $f does not start with #!/bin/bash"; continue; fi
  # Insert the line after the first line
  tail -n +2 "$f" > "$f.tmp"
  { head -n 1 "$f"; echo "set -euo pipefail"; cat "$f.tmp"; } > "$f.new"
  mv "$f.new" "$f" && rm -f "$f.tmp"
done && head -n 3 *.sh
